validity.researcher_notes: Trunkline Gas Pipeline is a major interstate transmission system operated by Energy Transfer (formerly Enbridge ownership, pre-2016 acquisition). Existence confirmed via Wikipedia and TGC system map. Pipeline remains operating as of 2026-09. Endpoints confirmed as Texas origin, Illinois/Indiana destination. CAVEAT: Wikipedia notes that in 2012 a 770-mile (1,240 km) section was announced to be converted to crude oil service, later (2014) formalized as ETCOP using 678 miles (1,091 km) of existing 30-inch Trunkline. The recorded length of 3932 km predates this conversion and refers to the original gas system extent. No material concerns found regarding classification or existence of gas transmission function.
